prompts.Affected UC-ID(s): List each known affected use; use Unknown when scope is not yet established.
prompts.How was it identified?: e.g. monitoring, user feedback, complaint, audit, supplier notice
prompts.Event classification: Incident / Near miss / Concern — near misses follow the same early-reporting and triage route
prompts.Immediate action taken: e.g. system paused, output withheld, users notified
prompts.Suspected personal data breach?: Yes / No / Uncertain — if Yes or Uncertain, refer to the DPO / Information Governance route now, before AI triage. Where notifiable, the ICO must be told without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after the Council becomes aware (UK GDPR Art 33). Date and time referred: ____
prompts.Security or safeguarding concern?: Yes / No — if Yes, refer now to the Information and Cyber Security lead or under the Council’s safeguarding procedures; those routes lead on their own duties (Playbook §6.8.6.5)
prompts.External notification may be required?: Yes / No / Unsure — e.g. ICO, other regulator, data subjects, partners; decided by the DPO or specialist route and recorded in §8
prompts.Part A sent to AI Governance Lead (date): Service Owner sends Part A the same working day

escalation.Low: Service Owner review and local remediation; Part A to the AI Governance Lead the same working day; logged in the incident record and summarised in the AIG-OPS-02 monitoring log within 10 working days (the AI Register holds only a link/status)
escalation.Medium: AI Governance Lead notified the same working day (Part A); documented remediation plan agreed within five working days
escalation.High: AI Governance Working Group within 2 working days; formal governance review
escalation.Critical: Immediate escalation, and within 24 hours at most, to AI Assurance Board, Executive Sponsor and Executive Leadership

prompts.Personal data breach confirmed?: Yes / No / Uncertain — DPO referral made at Part A §4 (date and DPO reference); the DPO and the data breach procedure lead
prompts.Controller awareness date and time: Record when the Council had a reasonable degree of certainty that a personal data breach occurred
prompts.Risk to individuals' rights and freedoms: Assessment, rationale, assessor and date; record whether risk or high risk is likely
prompts.ICO notifiability decision and DPO advic: Notifiable / Not notifiable / Further assessment; rationale, decision owner and DPO advice reference
prompts.ICO deadline and notification reference: If notifiable, notify without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after becoming aware (UK GDPR Art 33); reasons for any delay must accompany a late notification. Record deadline, sent time and delay reasons
prompts.Data-subject notification decision: Required / Not required — where a high risk to individuals is likely, tell data subjects without undue delay (UK GDPR Art 34); high-risk rationale, message owner, date and evidence reference
prompts.Other regulator, contractual or partner: Recipient, legal/contractual basis, deadline, owner, date and reference
prompts.Specialist routes engaged (Playbook §6.8: Tick and date each: data breach / DPO; cyber security; safeguarding; complaints; supplier / contract; corporate risk. The specialist route leads on its own duties; this record runs alongside it.
prompts.AIG-OPS-02 monitoring record updated?: Yes / No / N/A — record incident/near miss outcome and any changed monitoring requirement against the AIR-ID
prompts.Risk reassessment required?: Yes / No — mandatory documented consideration for material incidents, threshold breaches, recurring complaint patterns or adverse override trends
prompts.Residual risk / risk tier changed?: Yes / No — if Yes, update AIG-ASS-02 and current state in AIG-INV-04
prompts.Governance re-entry / Gate Log event req: Yes / No — if Yes, record decision/event in AIG-DEC-04
prompts.Lessons learned captured?: Yes / No — fed into continuous improvement
